title: North Pontotoc bowling picks up five new region opponents while Pontotoc adds Lake Cormorant
excerpt: Four Union County schools join North Pontotoc’s bowling region in 2027–28. This winter’s Jan. 18 regional tournament still uses the current alignment.
locality: Pontotoc High School and North Pontotoc High School, Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

Pontotoc High will add just one opponent, Lake Cormorant. The Mississippi High School Activities Association’s new assignments list the same opponents for the boys and girls at each school.

paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc’s bowlers will have five new region opponents in the 2027–28 school year, including four programs in neighboring Union County. Pontotoc High will add just one opponent, Lake Cormorant. The Mississippi High School Activities Association’s new assignments list the same opponents for the boys and girls at each school.

For North Pontotoc, the number on the region stays the same. The Vikings remain in Class I Region 2 with Choctaw Central and Nettleton. East Union, Myrtle, New Albany, West Union and Velma Jackson round out the new eight-school field. That gives North Pontotoc as many region opponents as it has this winter, even as most of the names change.

Five schools will leave North Pontotoc’s group after this season. Itawamba Agricultural, Mantachie and Tremont shift to Region 1. Nanih Waiya and Union are also on the Vikings’ current list and do not appear in their next Region 2. East Union, one of the five newcomers, is a separate school from Union.

Pontotoc has more continuity in Class II Region 1. Center Hill, Cleveland Central, Lafayette, Olive Branch and South Panola all stay in the Warriors’ group. Lake Cormorant brings it from six schools to seven. For families following either local team this winter, the association lists Jan. 18, 2027, for the regional tournament. This season still uses the 2025–27 assignments.
